title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Cola Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cola from Elfliq’s range of nic salt e-liquids has everything you want from a cola e-liquid, with the extra satisfaction of nic salt. Sweet, caramel notes of classic cola are the flavour that never goes out of fashion and this delicious e-liquid is a great example of a cola e-liquid in all it’s refreshing and familiar glory. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
